raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

LTX-2/2.3 two-stage runs stage 2, the distilled refiner, without CFG. Under `--enable-cfg-parallel`, `LTX2RefinementStage` was `MAIN_RANK_ONLY`, or `MAIN_RANK_ONLY_AND_SEND_TO_OTHERS` with parallel VAE decode. So on 2 GPUs one GPU sat idle for all of stage 2. At 768x512x121 on 2xH200 that is 3 steps at 0.394 s each.

TensorRT-LLM runs stage 2 as Ulysses 2 on the same ranks. In a 4xB300 benchmark round, sglang's stage 2 took 0.143 s/step x3 under breakable CUDA graphs, while TensorRT-LLM took 0.30 s for the whole of stage 2.

Sharding only pays off once stage 2 is long enough. At CI's 768x512x25 (1536 stage-2 tokens), it made `LTX2RefinementStage` slower, so the new path is gated on the stage-2 sequence length.

## Modifications

At stage-2 entry, every CFG rank already holds the same inputs:
- stage 1 combines the guided prediction with an all-reduce, so all CFG ranks hold the same latents after every step;
- the latent upsampler is replicated;
- stage 2 draws its re-noise from a generator re-seeded from the request seed. LTX-2 resets the batch generators and LTX-2.3 builds a fresh one, so every rank draws the same noise.

So a stage without CFG can be sequence-sharded over the CFG ranks instead of leaving them idle:

- `parallel_state.py`: when `cfg > 1` and `sp == 1`, the CFG ranks also form one pure-Ulysses group (`get_cfg_sequence_parallel_group()`). `SequenceParallelGroupCoordinator.over_group` builds it as a view over the CFG group's communicators. It adds no process group or NCCL communicator, and destroying the CFG group releases it.
- `use_sequence_parallel_group()` points the SP accessors at that group for one scope. Everything that reads `get_sp_group()` follows it: latent shard and gather, RoPE offsets, the Ulysses all-to-alls. The exchanges use the usual SP transports: the 2-rank CUDA-IPC all-to-all by default, otherwise NCCL.
- `stages/base.py`: new `StageParallelismType.SEQUENCE_PARALLEL_OVER_CFG_RANKS`. `parallel_executor.py` runs such a stage on every CFG rank inside that scope.
- The executor reads each stage's parallelism per batch through the new `PipelineStage.parallelism_type_for(batch)`, which defaults to `parallelism_type`.
- `LTX2RefinementStage.parallelism_type_for` returns the new type only when the group exists and stage 2 has at least `CFG_SP_MIN_TOKENS_PER_RANK` (2304) video tokens per rank. It reads the sequence length of the packed stage-2 latents, which every rank holds with the same shape, so all ranks pick the same path. Shorter requests keep the previous main-rank path, and so do CFG ranks that have SP of their own (`sp > 1`). A warmup takes the same path as serving at the same shape, so breakable CUDA graphs capture what serving replays.
- On the new path, stage 2 ends with the SP gather, so every rank holds the full latents for decode. With parallel decode, the post-stage batch broadcast no longer runs.

Tests: `test/unit/test_sequence_parallel_over_cfg_ranks.py` runs 2 gloo ranks on CPU with cfg=2, sp=1. It checks:
- the group is a view over the CFG communicators (same device group, Ulysses 2, ring 1), and the global SP size stays 1;
- the executor runs an `LTX2RefinementStage` batch one token per rank short of the threshold on the main rank only, and the other rank keeps its batch;
- a batch at the threshold runs on both ranks with SP world 2, and SP 1 is restored afterwards;
- inside the scope, LTX-2's video and audio latents round-trip exactly through shard and gather, the shard's start frame follows the rank, and Ulysses attention matches single-rank SDPA for both sharded and replicated inputs.

No files are shared with #45942, #45943, #45944 or #45948, and this PR merges cleanly with all four. With parallel VAE decode, stage 2 now leaves the full latents on both ranks instead of broadcasting the batch. #45942 changes the decode itself, so the two PRs are independent. Stage 2's exchange runs on the 2-rank IPC transport, which #45948 (N-rank transport) does not touch.

## Accuracy Tests

2xH200, LTX-2 two-stage 768x512x121, `--enable-cfg-parallel`, against main:

- PSNR 33.4–35.7 dB, high-frequency energy unchanged. The output is not bitwise equal: stage-2 attention now runs on two head shards, which reorders the sums.
- Breakable CUDA graphs: no hang, and the output is bitwise equal to eager in every arm. Main captures 3 graphs, with stage 2 on rank 0 only. This PR captures 4, with stage 2 on both ranks at (1, 3072, 128).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

2xH200, LTX-2 two-stage 768x512x121, `--enable-cfg-parallel`. Server benchmark with a fresh server per run, arms interleaved.

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| stage-2 step, eager | 0.394 s | 0.280 s (−29%) |
| stage-2 step, breakable CUDA graphs | 0.365 s | 0.2345 s (−36%) |
| e2e, default profile (eager) | 7.336 s | 6.877 s (−6.3%) |
| e2e, breakable CUDA graphs | 5.966 s | 5.386 s (−9.7%) |
| peak memory GPU0 / GPU1, breakable CUDA graphs | 85.2 / 78.1 GB | 80.8 / 80.6 GB |

- The compile profile went from 10.508 s to 9.757 s, but that was measured with this change stacked on other pending changes.
- Eager peak memory is 0.8–1.8 GB higher.
- VAE decode is slightly slower on this branch under breakable CUDA graphs: 0.665 s to 0.715 s. The e2e numbers above include it.
- 121 frames is above the threshold below, so the gate keeps these numbers. LTX-2.3 is measured in the next section.

### Sequence-length gate

2xH200, two-stage 768x512, `--enable-cfg-parallel --dit-layerwise-offload false --performance-mode speed`, eager. Server benchmark, one warm request per shape, then medians of the measured requests. LTX-2 25/57/89/121 frames ran in 2 interleaved rounds (n≥4); the other shapes ran on one server per arm (n=2–4). The server rounds the frame count so the latent frames split evenly over 2 GPUs, so the table lists the served frames. "Step" is `[LTX2RefinementStage] average time per step`, and "e2e" is the server's request time.

LTX-2:

| frames (served) | stage-2 tokens | per rank | main step | ungated step | gated step | main e2e | ungated e2e | gated path |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 1536 | 768 | 203 ms | 277 ms | 200 ms | 6.21 s | 6.40 s | main rank |
| 57 | 3072 | 1536 | 210 ms | 280 ms | 209 ms | 6.48 s | 6.68 s | main rank |
| 73 | 3840 | 1920 | 254 ms | 280 ms | 254 ms | 6.74 s | 6.65 s | main rank |
| 89 | 4608 | 2304 | 304 ms | 282 ms | 274 ms | 6.93 s | 6.75 s | SP over CFG |
| 105 | 5376 | 2688 | 363 ms | 282 ms | – | 7.04 s | 6.80 s | SP over CFG |
| 121 | 6144 | 3072 | 397 ms | 280 ms | 277 ms | 7.38 s | 6.91 s | SP over CFG |

- The ungated step stays at about 280 ms at every length. Eager stage 2 is host-bound at these sizes, and Ulysses adds about 75 ms of host work per step. So the new path wins only once the main rank's step passes that floor, between 1920 and 2304 tokens per rank (about 2.1k by interpolation). The threshold is 2304, the first measured win (−7% per step).
- End to end, the crossover is lower, at about 1.6–1.9k tokens per rank. Between stage 2 and decode, the main-rank path also spends 80–160 ms broadcasting the batch, which the new path skips. At 1920 tokens per rank, the gate gives up about 30 ms e2e to keep the faster stage 2.
- Stage 1 varies by about ±100 ms between server launches. That is why the e2e columns are noisier than the step columns.
- CI's `ltx_2_two_stage_t2v` settings (default serve args, 768x512x25): `LTX2RefinementStage` takes 590 ms on main, 841 ms ungated, and 609 ms gated.

LTX-2.3 (`Lightricks/LTX-2.3`, same flags):

| frames (served) | per rank | main step | ungated step | gated step | main e2e | ungated e2e | gated path |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 768 | 147 ms | 221 ms | 145 ms | 5.61 s | 5.76 s | main rank |
| 73 | 1920 | 226 ms | 224 ms | – | 6.16 s | 6.18 s | main rank |
| 89 | 2304 | 265 ms | 282 ms | 287 ms | 6.57 s | 6.49 s | SP over CFG |
| 105 | 2688 | 320 ms | 307 ms | – | 7.67 s | 7.50 s | SP over CFG |
| 121 | 3072 | 352 ms | 229 ms | 226 ms | 8.16 s | 7.66 s | SP over CFG |

- On LTX-2.3, the ungated step does not grow monotonically with length: 224, 282, 307 and 229 ms at 1920 to 3072 tokens per rank. At 2304 tokens per rank, the new path makes its stage 2 6% slower. The request is still about 74 ms faster, because the batch broadcast is skipped.

Breakable CUDA graphs, with warmup at the serving shape (LTX-2, n=2):

| frames | main step / graphs | ungated step / graphs | gated step / graphs | main e2e | ungated e2e | gated e2e |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 87.1 ms / 3 | 91.5 ms / 4 | 87.4 ms / 3 | 2.53 s | 2.39 s | 2.52 s |
| 121 | 367.4 ms / 3 | 236.6 ms / 4 | 237.2 ms / 4 | 6.02 s | 5.44 s | 5.43 s |

- The gated server captures the graphs of the path it serves: 3 graphs at 25 frames (stage 2 on rank 0 only), 4 at 121 frames.
- Graphs remove the host floor, so at 25 frames the new path is only 5% slower per step. The request is 141 ms faster because the batch broadcast is skipped. The eager-measured threshold gives up that win for short requests under graphs.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    @classmethod
+    def over_group(
+        cls, group: GroupCoordinator, ring_group: ProcessGroup

+        """Pure-Ulysses SP over ``group``'s ranks that reuses its communicators.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""A stage without CFG shards a long enough sequence over the CFG ranks as one Ulysses group."""
+
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.ltx_2 import LTX2PipelineConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed import group_coordinator
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed import parallel_state as ps
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.layer import USPAttention
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.managers.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.executors.parallel_executor import (
+    ParallelExecutor,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.schedule_batch import Req
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.ltx_2.denoising_av import (
+    CFG_SP_MIN_TOKENS_PER_RANK,
+    LTX2RefinementStage,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import AttentionBackendEnum
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms.cpu import CpuPlatform
+
+
+class _Sdpa:
+    def forward(self, q, k, v, _ctx):
+        return F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
+        ).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ulysses_attention() -> USPAttention:
+    attn = USPAttention.__new__(USPAttention)
+    attn.attn_impl = _Sdpa()
+    attn.backend = AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA
+    attn.skip_sequence_parallel = False
+    attn.enable_packed_qkv_input_a2a = False
+    attn.sp_attention_mode = "ulysses"
+    attn.sp_attention_mode_is_auto = False
+    return attn
+
+
+def _check_folded_topology(rank, rendezvous):
+    with patch.object(group_coordinator, "current_platform", CpuPlatform()):
+        ps.init_distributed_environment(
+            world_size=2,
+            rank=rank,
+            distributed_init_method=rendezvous,
+            local_rank=rank,
+            backend="gloo",
+            timeout=60,
+        )
+        ps.initialize_model_parallel(
+            classifier_free_guidance_degree=2,
+            sequence_parallel_degree=1,
+            backend="gloo",
+        )
+    try:
+        folded = ps.get_cfg_sequence_parallel_group()
+        cfg = ps.get_cfg_group()
+        # a view over the CFG communicators: no new process group per rank
+        assert folded.device_group is cfg.device_group
+        assert folded.ulysses_group is cfg.device_group
+        assert (folded.ranks, folded.rank_in_group) == (cfg.ranks, cfg.rank_in_group)
+        assert (folded.ulysses_world_size, folded.ulysses_rank) == (2, rank)
+        assert folded.ring_world_size == 1
+        assert ps.get_sp_world_size() == 1
+
+        stage = object.__new__(LTX2RefinementStage)
+        stage.server_args = SimpleNamespace(enable_cfg_parallel=True)
+        stage.vae = None
+        min_tokens = 2 * CFG_SP_MIN_TOKENS_PER_RANK
+        short, long = (
+            Req(sampling_params=SamplingParams(), latents=torch.empty(1, n, 1))
+            for n in (min_tokens - 2, min_tokens)
+        )
+        server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+            enable_cfg_parallel=True, enable_layerwise_nvtx_marker=False
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                ParallelExecutor,
+                "_component_residency_request",
+                lambda *args: nullcontext(),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                ParallelExecutor,
+                "_run_stage_with_executor_hooks",
+                lambda self, stage, index, batch, args, run_stage, nvtx: run_stage(
+                    stage, batch
+                ),
+            ),
+        ):
+            executor = ParallelExecutor.__new__(ParallelExecutor)
+            seen_short, seen_long = (
+                executor._execute_stages(
+                    [stage],
+                    batch,
+                    server_args,
+                    lambda *_: (ps.get_sp_world_size(), ps.get_sp_parallel_rank()),
+                )
+                for batch in (short, long)
+            )
+        # a short stage 2 runs on the main rank alone; the other keeps its batch
+        if rank == 0:
+            assert seen_short == (1, 0)
+        else:
+            assert seen_short is short
+        # a long one runs on every CFG rank inside the folded scope
+        assert seen_long == (2, rank)
+        assert ps.get_sp_world_size() == 1
+
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        config = LTX2PipelineConfig()
+        tokens_per_frame = 6
+        video = torch.randn(1, 16 * tokens_per_frame, 8)
+        audio = torch.randn(1, 7, 8)
+        q, k, v = (torch.randn(1, 8, 4, 16) for _ in range(3))
+        expected = _Sdpa().forward(q, k, v, None)
+        local = slice(4 * rank, 4 * rank + 4)
+        attn = _ulysses_attention()
+        with (
+            ps.use_sequence_parallel_group(folded),
+            set_forward_context(current_timestep=0, attn_metadata=None),
+        ):
+            batch = Req(
+                height=config.vae_scale_factor * config.patch_size * 2,
+                width=config.vae_scale_factor * config.patch_size * 3,
+            )
+            video_shard, _ = config.shard_latents_for_sp(batch, video)
+            audio_shard, _ = config.shard_audio_latents_for_sp(batch, audio)
+            assert video_shard.shape[1] == 8 * tokens_per_frame
+            assert batch.sp_video_start_frame == 8 * rank
+            assert audio_shard.shape[1] == 4 and batch.sp_audio_has_padding
+            video_gathered = config.gather_latents_for_sp(video_shard, batch)
+            audio_gathered = config.gather_audio_latents_for_sp(audio_shard, batch)
+
+            out = attn.forward(q[:, local], k[:, local], v[:, local])
+            # LTX-2 keeps audio whole under SP: every key appears once per rank,
+            # so the gathered duplicates leave each softmax unchanged
+            replicated = attn.forward(q, k, v)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(video_gathered, video, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(audio_gathered, audio, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected[:, local])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(replicated, expected)
+        assert ps.get_sp_world_size() == 1
+    finally:
+        ps.destroy_model_parallel()
+        ps.destroy_distributed_environment()
+    assert ps.get_cfg_sequence_parallel_group() is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    torch.version.hip is not None,
+    reason="ROCm builds query GPU 0 while importing sglang, which fails with the "
+    "GPUs hidden for these CPU workers",
+)
+def test_stage_without_cfg_shards_over_cfg_ranks(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    # gloo ranks on CPU: hide the GPUs so no communicator binds rank 1 to a
+    # device a 1-GPU runner lacks, and keep the CUDA-IPC all-to-all off
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_DIFFUSION_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE", "cpu")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_DIFFUSION_IPC_A2A", "0")
+    rendezvous = (tmp_path / "rendezvous").as_uri()
+    mp.spawn(_check_folded_topology, args=(rendezvous,), nprocs=2)
